title: Chapter 591
text:
This railgun was called 'Eye of God'. It was a space-based satellite weapon and could move independently from the spaceship. It was placed at the edge of outer space and the atmosphere, orbiting around the planet.

The Eye of God was not a particle beam weapon like the main cannon of Dark-star. Instead, it used a physical shell. The size of the bullet was very large, and it could be combined with different types of ammunition. There were more tactical options. It could hit the surface from outer space and gain more kinetic energy through the acceleration and gravity acceleration. With the support of his Virtual Technology algorithm, the coordinates of the attack were very accurate.

The cost of making this railgun was very high, second only to the Berserk Ape mechanical suit. This did not include the cost of every shot.

After spending so much money, the return was naturally not bad. The attack power of the Eye of God was very high. It was like a huge cannon placed in outer space. There were only two limitations. First, its attack speed was very slow, and the shell had to fly for a while.

Second, it could not be used in galactic battles and could only be used to attack the surface. It was very suitable for the mercenary business of airdropping cabins.

This weapon was the most destructive means Han Xiao had, but he only had one at the moment. The Strategic Support Style was only in its infancy. However, Han Xiao had money in his pocket, so he could make more if he had the time.

After the Strategic Support Style was fully formed, it would not take long for hundreds of railguns to fire at the same time to flatten the surface of an asteroid. It fully demonstrated the logic of the Mechanic class being rich.

When other Supers were stuck at a bottleneck, only the Mechanic class could steadily increase their combat power by burning money.

"With this set of equipment, I can finally be considered to have the strength of my level."

Han Xiao nodded in his mind.

The total cost was close to a million Enas. After updating all his combat machines, his destructive power had truly reached the level of a 'Natural Disaster'. He could summon a nuclear bomb at any time and destroy the ecology on the surface of a planet.

The Watcher Protocol, Mechanical Prosthesis, Short Range Warp Engine, Mech Legion No. 004 and No. 005, Electromagnetic Swamp, Eye of God … After roughly counting all his machines, Han Xiao packed up the compressed orbs and wore them on his body. Large weapons like the Mech Legion and space-based satellites were placed in the spaceship warehouse.

Other than the combat machines, Han Xiao had also fused an interesting blueprint during this period of time. He had also built it for spaceship boarding battles.

The Ravager's charge cabin was a landing device.

This was an external suspension cabin that was installed on the spaceship. It was equipped with shock-absorbing equipment, and a portion of the landing crew could ride inside. The moment the enemy spaceship's shield was broken, the assault cabin would launch out and bite the enemy spaceship. Then, the assault cabin would be inserted into the enemy spaceship's outer armor through the assault cabin's embedded equipment. The hot melting and cutting equipment would burn open the armor and send the landing crew inside into the enemy spaceship … Of course, if the situation was not good, the assault cabin could also self-destruct.

In interstellar wars, charge cabins were often used. The people who landed inside naturally had no way to retreat. They would fight to the death. If they didn't succeed, they would die trying. Basically, they were a suicide squad.

Han Xiao felt that this thing was very suitable for players. That was the real "dare-to-die" team.

Just the thought of raising both hands high and shouting "wula wula" or something like that was very cool.

Han Xiao had recently been researching the Berserker Falcon class spaceship, but he was missing a part of his knowledge. He was stuck in the process of reverse-engineering. In his previous life, high-level Mechanic class players could also build spaceships, but it was basically a team job. Everyone had different knowledge, so they had to assemble different parts.

Han Xiao did not want to divide the work. He wanted to learn the entire process of building spaceships.

Building spaceships independently was a milestone special Legendary Point, just like the [Legendary Hunter] milestone that he had yet to complete.

However, he was still missing a part of his knowledge, and he was currently lacking Potential Points. This was a little difficult.

After entering the galaxy, Han Xiao did not harvest experience on a large scale. He mainly harvested wallets.

After all, after leveling up, he needed time to update his equipment. Furthermore, he had spent quite a lot of experience to upgrade and fuse blueprints.

Therefore, his current experience reserve was almost empty.

"I'll find a time to harvest a wave of experience …"

Han Xiao pondered.

His equipment had been updated. Other than obtaining Potential Points, he also needed to continue increasing his strength.

"I'm now level 142. Although I've just entered Grade A, with a full set of equipment, my combat strength can be compared to people of higher levels. Furthermore, my talent is very tanky, so I have a huge advantage. If the opponent's ability is too common, my chances of winning will be greatly increased …"

Han Xiaoxin evaluated his own combat strength. Generally speaking, most people in Galaxy would enter Grade A between level 150 and 160, depending on their talents, skills, and attributes. However, he had entered Grade A at level 140. Even among those amazing protagonists, this was rare.

After reaching Grade A, every twenty levels of Promotion or every Main Class Class Advancement could be considered as a watershed. Han Xiao was currently between level 140 and level 160, so the EXP required to level up was very high. Almost all of them started at one billion EXP.

In his previous life, by the time the level cap was released, the experience required to level up was already in the tens of millions. Even so, players still needed to work hard for a long time before they could level up.

Even if he could take advantage of the players, it was still very difficult to accumulate enough experience to reach level 160. In the short term, there was no hope of Promotion. However, there was another way to increase his strength, which was to change his main class.

Han Xiao's [Virtual Mechanic] was currently level 17. He only needed three more levels before he could change his class, which would cost him about three billion experience.

This time, Han Xiao did not plan to sell knowledge. That was a one-time sale, and there was a limited amount. Furthermore, it was not suitable to give it to the players at once.

He decided to teach the blueprint skills. This was a larger chain of benefits.

Although the blueprint skills were only targeted at Mechanic players, and the profit was not as high as Promotion knowledge, the advantage was that there were too many blueprints that could be fused from different knowledge combinations. In Version 1.0, Han Xiao pretended to be a Mechanic instructor and tricked more players into changing their class to Mechanic in order to expand the market for blueprint skills.

Furthermore, he did not only sell low-level blueprints to the players. He could also sell high-level blueprints.

The players did not have enough knowledge, so even if they bought high-level blueprints, they would not be able to use them for the time being. However, there would still be people who would buy them … because having a high-level blueprint that they could not use for the time being was better than not having one.

He had never underestimated the desire of the Chinese players to stock up.

Thinking of the players … Han Xiao opened the forums and took a look. The forums were bustling all the time.

The strategic equipment that he had sold the last time was used by the players in their new employment missions. Many people took screenshots and shared them. Among them, the Worker Bee Armor was especially well received. It allowed many life players to find a new source of income. Fighting and killing were not good. Mining was more practical!

The second most well received item was actually the Nuclear Magnetic Flying Backpack. The focus of the comments was not on the flying backpack but on the explosion.

This made Han Xiao even more confident in the Raider Charge Cabin.

He knew that self-destruction was the best match for the players!

He scanned through a few pages of posts. Other than sharing posts, chatting posts, and spamming posts, there were also some high-level players making guides and introducing new strategies. After looking for a while, Han Xiao suddenly realized that one of the posts had become popular, and it quickly rose to the top.

Wayne Card Beginner's Guide: Third Issue

He clicked in and took a look. The player who made the post was obviously mesmerized by the Wayne Card. He did not use the money he earned to buy equipment but actually used it all to make up a deck …

Wow, a salted fish!

Playing with these fancy things every day instead of focusing on killing monsters?!

"These players have been corrupted by the Wayne Cards …"

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Could it be that the Wayne Card was his biggest business competitor?

After a rough glance, he realized that the Shattered Star Ring Card Deck had been updated. This was also the focus of the post. The Black Star Corps was among the updated cards.

—

Shattered Star Ring Card Deck Adjustments:

Mercenary Card [Black Star Mercenary] changed to Mercenary Card/Force Card [Black Star Corps]. Card attributes increased, new special effect added.

Civilization Card [Godora] Card attributes increased.

Force Card [Floating Dragon Island] Card attributes increased.

Strong Card ['Black Star' Han Xiao] added.

History Card [Destruction of Dark-star] added.

Original Force Card [Dark-star] moved to Discarded Card Deck.

—

Han Xiao instantly understood why this post had suddenly become popular.

In the eyes of the players, the Black Star Corps represented their faction. Seeing their faction appear in the deck, the players were extremely excited. The way they saw it, the changes to the Wayne Card reflected the results of their contribution to the growth of their faction.

The update of the Wayne Card showed the trend of all the regions in Galaxy to a certain extent. There was actually a new Strong Card that was exclusive to him, and the attributes of the Strong Card were not bad …

This meant that his deeds had already spread far and wide, and he had already become a famous person.

Han Xiaoxin suddenly realized that the Wayne Card seemed to be a set of hidden rankings, showing a person's fame and status in the galaxy.

…

After looking at the forums for a while and taking some potions from Sykes and the other secret prisoners, Han Xiao closed the door and left the machinery modification room.

Although he had delayed building machinery for almost two months, Han Xiao did not forget about the mission of sending Hella and Aurora to Floating Dragon.

Now that the Black Star Corps had expanded, the players and normal mercenaries shared a large number of missions, and he did not seem to have received any difficult missions that required him to personally take part in. Therefore, Han Xiao decided to complete Ames' instructions first.

Hella was usually in the Combat Training Room, and Aurora should be there as well.

On the way, he met Sylvia, who had a panicked look on her face as if she was hiding from something. She hurriedly greeted him and ran away. Han Xiao did not take it to heart. After walking for a while, he saw Reynold looking around at the intersection, so he went up and said a few words of encouragement. Seeing that Reynold was about to take out his little notebook, Han Xiao hurriedly shut up and walked away with large strides.

When he arrived at the Combat Training Room, as expected, Hella was undergoing actual combat training there, and Aurora was also forcefully dragged to join in.

Due to her past experience, Hella's pursuit of strength was very strong. After entering the galaxy and seeing so many strong people, her sense of danger had become more and more serious. She wished that she could not sleep every day and spend all her time on training.

The effect was also very obvious. The Combat Training Room of the galactic era could simulate actual combat and force out the combat potential of Supers. Hella's talent had always been very good, and coupled with her hard work, her strength had increased by quite a lot recently. A few days ago, Han Xiao sparred with Hella and found that Hella had already leveled up a few times.

Han Xiao opened the door, and the virtual combat scene disappeared.

Hella then stopped, wiped the sweat on her forehead with the back of her hand, and said with a frown, "What are you doing here? Do you want to spar?"

She was currently wearing a black battle suit that was extremely tight. It looked like a layer of black skin, outlining her fiery figure. Her front and back were perky, extremely provocative.

Han Xiao looked and shook his head helplessly. He could not help but say, "I say, can't you change into a more useful combat suit? Don't I have armor for you to choose?"

"It's too cumbersome."

Hella showed a look of disdain.

"What cumbersome? That's called safety. Aren't you just saying that it doesn't look good? What do you know about aesthetics?"

Han Xiao rolled his eyes. Tsk, woman.

While the two of them were arguing, Aurora held her knees with both hands, bent over, and panted. She could not even speak.

She was forced to participate in the special training, and she could not keep up with Hella's strength. She was so tired that her whole body was about to fall apart.

However, Aurora was not unwilling at all. She had gone through tough times and knew the importance of strength. She did not do the special training half-heartedly, which was why she was so tired. After all, virtual combat would not cause real damage. If she had just been slacking, she would not be so tired.

Han Xiao took out a high-energy nutrition bar, threw it to Aurora, and said, "Alright, stop training. Pack up, I'll bring you to Floating Dragon Island."

Aurora heard this and hurriedly stopped tearing the packaging of the nutrition bar. She said in surprise, "Can I finally see Big Sister Ames?"

Hella's eyes sparkled, and her lips curled up slightly. After entering the galaxy, she completely understood Ames' reputation in the universe. She had been looking forward to officially training with her for a long time.

Beep beep beep!

Han Xiao was about to say a few more words when his communicator suddenly rang. He took it out and saw that it was actually a communication request from Ames. She said that the Dragon Emperor had arrived.

"Ames?"

"Hmm, Black Star, when will you send my students over?" Ames' projection appeared. She had a half-smile on her face, and a pair of long, white, python-like legs appeared in front of Han Xiao's eyes.

"I was dealing with some things previously, so it took some time. I'll send them to Floating Dragon Island in a few days." Han Xiao nodded.

"Okay." Ames pondered for a while and suddenly said, "You better come quickly. When you arrive, I want you to accompany me to a place."

"Where?"

"Bloodshed Land."

Ames' tone was calm, and no emotions could be heard.

Han Xiao raised his brows and had an ominous feeling. He felt that his leisure time was about to disappear again.

"Can I not go?"

"Humph, no."
